events.name: Bash
events.head: Check main state, Calendly leftovers, coord log
events.input: $ git fetch -q origin && git log --oneline -1 origin/main && git rev-parse HEAD && git grep -n -i calendly 15373459 -- cloud/funnel/worker.js cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py | head; tail -15 /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | cut -c1-300; grep -n -i "publish held" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find deploy notes and run done_when grep on main
events.input: $ M=/Users/adithyamurali/.claude/projects/-Users-adithyamurali-tantra-redesign/memory; ls $M | grep -i -E "deploy|mirror|publish" ; for n in godaddy "microsoft 365" instantly sendgrid zerobounce neverbounce builtwith heyreach calendly apollo "whatsapp cloud"; do echo "$n: $(git grep -il "$n" origin/main -- app/src cloud/src workshop-plan/survey.html | grep -v examples/data | tr '\n' ' ')"; done

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read deploy and mirror procedure notes
events.input: $ M=/Users/adithyamurali/.claude/projects/-Users-adithyamurali-tantra-redesign/memory; cat $M/centre-deploy-clean-worktree.md $M/mirror-export-clean-worktree.md $M/mirror-publish-holds.md | head -90

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check publish holds, worktrees, live mirror location
events.input: $ grep -n -i "held\|NOT publish\|hold" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -5 | cut -c1-200; ls workshop-plan/coord/LOG.md 2>/dev/null && grep -n -i "publish held\|NOT publish" workshop-plan/coord/LOG.md | tail -3 | cut -c1-200; git worktree list | head; ls -d /Users/adithyamurali/*live* /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/live 2>/dev/null

events.name: Bash
events.head: Create clean worktree, tsc and dry-run deploy
events.input: $ set -e; R=/Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; W=/private/tmp/t300-deploy; git -C $R worktree add -q --detach $W 15373459; ln -s $R/cloud/node_modules $W/cloud/node_modules; rsync -a $R/cloud/public/ $W/cloud/public/; mkdir -p $W/cloud/public/admin; cp -R $W/cloud/admin-ui/. $W/cloud/public/admin/; cd $W/cloud && npx tsc --noEmit -p . && echo TSC_OK; npx wrangler deploy --dry-run 2>&1 | tail -4

events.text: Worktree is clean and the dry run passed. Deploying the revops-centre Worker now.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Deploy revops-centre Worker from clean worktree
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t300-deploy/cloud && npx wrangler deploy 2>&1 | grep -E -i "upload|deployed|version|error" | head -10

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check how funnel worker ships; probe live centre
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t300-deploy && git grep -n "funnel/worker" -- cloud/src cloud/wrangler* cloud/package.json | head -5; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" "https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev/hooks/calendly?v=t300"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" "https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev/?v=t300"

events.name: Bash
events.head: Grep deployed bundle for removed Calendly code
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t300-deploy/cloud && npx wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir /tmp/t300-bundle >/dev/null 2>&1; for t in calendlyPoll calendlyApply "/hooks/calendly" "calendly:invitee.created" sendgrid; do echo "$t: $(grep -o "$t" -r /tmp/t300-bundle | wc -l)"; done

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect live mirror repo and export script
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/live && git status --short | head -5; git log --oneline -2; git remote -v | head -1; git fetch -q && git status -sb | head -1; sed -n 1,30p /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app/scripts/export-static.sh | grep -v "^\s*$" | head -30; grep -n -i survey /Users/adithyamurali/.claude/projects/-Users-adithyamurali-tantra-redesign/memory/integrator-publish-gotchas.md | head -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: Locate survey in live mirror and compare
events.input: $ git ls-files | grep -i survey | head; R=/Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; for f in $(git ls-files | grep -i 'survey.*html$' | head -3); do b=$(basename $f); echo "$f vs workshop-plan/$b:"; git -C $R show 15373459:workshop-plan/$b 2>/dev/null | cmp - $f && echo SAME; grep -c -i -E "godaddy|sendgrid|apollo|builtwith" $f; done

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find how survey.html is published
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign && git grep -n "survey.html" 15373459 -- '*.sh' '*.py' '*.mjs' 'app/public' | grep -v -i probe | head -8; git ls-tree -r --name-only 15373459 | grep -i "materials/survey\|public/survey" | head

events.text: Worker is deployed (version 7a94c18c, bundle has no Calendly code). Now checking the survey source before exporting the mirror.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Compare survey sources and find root copy step
events.input: $ git show 15373459:app/public/materials/survey.html > /tmp/t300-s1; git show 15373459:workshop-plan/survey.html > /tmp/t300-s2; cmp /tmp/t300-s1 /tmp/t300-s2 && echo SRC_SAME; grep -c -i -E "godaddy|sendgrid|apollo|builtwith|calendly|instantly|heyreach" /tmp/t300-s1; cmp /tmp/t300-s1 live/survey.html; git grep -n -E "live/(survey|\*\.html)|cp .*workshop-plan.*live" 15373459 -- '*.sh' '*.py' '*.md' | head -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: Diff live root HTML against main sources
events.input: $ for f in live/*.html; do b=$(basename $f); if git cat-file -e 15373459:workshop-plan/$b 2>/dev/null; then git show 15373459:workshop-plan/$b | cmp -s - $f && echo "same $b" || echo "DIFF $b"; fi; done; git log --oneline 15373459 --author="" --grep="T-300" -- 'workshop-plan/*.html' | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check T-300 workshop-plan files and deck/playbook drift
events.input: $ git show --stat --format= fcaaebdf 184d5cb2 | grep workshop-plan/ | grep -v tasks; for b in deck playbook; do echo "== $b"; git show 15373459:workshop-plan/$b.html | diff live/$b.html - | grep -c "^[<>]"; git log -1 --format="%h %ad %s" --date=short 15373459 -- workshop-plan/$b.html; (cd live && git log -1 --format="%h %ad %s" --date=short -- $b.html); done

events.name: Bash
events.head: Show playbook live vs main diff
events.input: $ git show 15373459:workshop-plan/playbook.html | diff live/playbook.html - | head -30 | cut -c1-220

events.name: Bash
events.head: Build root playbook with path rewrite and diff
events.input: $ git show 15373459:workshop-plan/playbook.html | sed 's#"\.\./guides/#"site/guides/#g' > /tmp/t300-pb.html; diff live/playbook.html /tmp/t300-pb.html | grep "^[<>]" | grep -c -v -i -E "verif|check|list"; diff live/playbook.html /tmp/t300-pb.html | grep "^>" | cut -c1-160 | head -20; grep -c '\.\./' /tmp/t300-pb.html

events.name: Bash
events.head: Dry-run applying T-300 playbook hunks to live copy
events.input: $ cp live/playbook.html /tmp/t300-pb-live.html && git show fcaaebdf -- workshop-plan/playbook.html | patch --dry-run /tmp/t300-pb-live.html 2>&1 | tail -4

events.text: Applying only the T-300 playbook edits to the live copy, because the full main playbook carries walkthrough videos that are on hold. Checking the deck next.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check deck changes since last mirror publish
events.input: $ git log --oneline 711a8fc..15373459 -- workshop-plan/deck.html workshop-plan/survey.html app/public/materials/survey.html | head; git show 711a8fc:workshop-plan/deck.html | cmp - live/deck.html && echo DECK_LIVE_EQ_711a8fc

events.name: Bash
events.head: Export static mirror from clean worktree
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t300-deploy && cp -Rc /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app/node_modules app/node_modules && ln -sf /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app/.env.local app/.env.local && (bash app/scripts/export-static.sh > /tmp/t300-export.log 2>&1; echo "EXIT $?" >> /tmp/t300-export.log)

events.name: Bash
events.head: Prepare root playbook, deck and survey files
events.input: $ patch -s /tmp/t300-pb-live.html < <(git show fcaaebdf -- workshop-plan/playbook.html) && grep -c -i -E "verify every email|email verifier|verified prospect list" /tmp/t300-pb-live.html; git show 15373459:workshop-plan/deck.html > /tmp/t300-deck.html; grep -c -i -E "zerobounce|neverbounce|verify every|calendly|sendgrid|apollo|godaddy|builtwith" /tmp/t300-deck.html /tmp/t300-s1; grep -c "walkthroughs/" /tmp/t300-pb-live.html

events.name: Bash
events.head: Confirm patch did not add held videos
events.input: $ grep -c "walkthroughs/" live/playbook.html; grep -c "<video" live/playbook.html /tmp/t300-pb-live.html; diff live/playbook.html /tmp/t300-pb-live.html | grep -c "^>"

events.text: The root playbook gets just the 11 T-300 line changes and nothing else. Waiting for the static export to finish.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Wait for export to finish
events.input: $ until grep -q "^EXIT" /tmp/t300-export.log; do sleep 15; done; tail -4 /tmp/t300-export.log

events.name: Bash
events.head: Dry-run rsync export into live/site
events.input: $ E=/private/tmp/t300-deploy/.export-scratch/.next-export; ls $E | head -3; ls $E | wc -l; grep -c -i -E "godaddy|sendgrid|apollo|builtwith" $E/materials/survey.html; cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/live && rsync -a --checksum --delete -n -i $E/ site/ | grep -E "^(>f|\*deleting)" > /tmp/t300-rsync.txt; wc -l < /tmp/t300-rsync.txt; grep -c deleting /tmp/t300-rsync.txt; grep -v "_next/static" /tmp/t300-rsync.txt | head -30

events.name: Bash
events.head: Summarise rsync changes and deletions
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/live; grep deleting /tmp/t300-rsync.txt; grep -v "_next/" /tmp/t300-rsync.txt | grep -v -E "\.txt$|index\.html$" | head -20; grep -v "_next/" /tmp/t300-rsync.txt | awk '{print $2}' | cut -d/ -f1 | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -12

events.text: Only old build chunks are deleted; the rest are normal page rebuilds plus the survey, deck and playbook copies. Syncing and pushing the mirror.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Sync export, copy root files, commit and push mirror
events.input: $ set -e; cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/live; E=/private/tmp/t300-deploy/.export-scratch/.next-export; git pull -q --ff-only; rsync -a --checksum --delete $E/ site/; cp /tmp/t300-s1 survey.html; cp /tmp/t300-deck.html deck.html; cp /tmp/t300-pb-live.html playbook.html; git add -A site survey.html deck.html playbook.html; git status --short | grep -v "site/" ; git status --short | wc -l; git commit -q -m "Mirror: T-300 ruled-out tools removed, free list checks only in survey, deck and playbook (main 15373459)" && git push -q origin main 2>&1 | tail -2; git log --oneline -1

events.name: Bash
events.head: Verify live mirror pages after Pages rebuild
events.input: $ B=https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live; for i in $(seq 1 40); do n=$(curl -s "$B/survey.html?v=t300$i" | grep -c -i -E "godaddy|sendgrid|apollo|builtwith"); [ "$n" = 0 ] && break; sleep 15; done; echo "root survey hits: $n (try $i)"; for p in site/materials/survey.html deck.html site/materials/deck.html playbook.html site/materials/playbook.html; do echo "$p: $(curl -s -w ' %{http_code}' "$B/$p?v=t300b" | grep -o -i -E "godaddy|sendgrid|apollo|builtwith|zerobounce|neverbounce|calendly|verify every email|email verifier| [0-9]{3}$" | sort | uniq -c | tr '\n' ' ')"; done
